title: G13: Guardian report from ProgressStore events (M)
description:
A guardian report built from ProgressStore events, to answer the Wave 0 playtest questions with evidence.
Acceptance:
- Given a progress export, the report lists per lesson: time to first action, Continue-only count, prediction accuracy, rung 3 / Show me share, challenges tried, abandonments.
- It contains no personal data beyond the local student name.
- It is available from a settings or guardian page and as an export file.
right_now_summary: The team is defining a guardian report with lesson metrics, privacy limits, and export support.
